name: Kanban
author: ryong256
description: Open task indicator for the kb board: an icon in the bar, the count on hover, click to open the board TUI.

barWidget.description: One icon in the bar. Hovering reports open tasks across every registered project, read from `kb count --json --all`; clicking opens the board in a terminal, focusing an existing window when one is already up.

schema.label: Hide the widget when no tasks are open
